formulas.ascii: Pieces of the pipeline, not the whole procedure: core distance = distance to the minimumSamples-th nearest point (the point counts as its own first neighbour); mutual reachability d_mr(a, b) = max(core(a), core(b), |x_a - x_b|); the minimum spanning tree over d_mr gives the single-linkage dendrogram, which is condensed to clusters of at least minimumClusterSize points. Stability S(C) = sum over points p of C of (lambda_p - lambda_birth(C)) with lambda = 1 / distance. Excess-of-mass selection keeps a cluster when its stability exceeds the summed stability of its selected descendants; every other point is noise (0xffffffff).
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
offsets[i] = sum(flags[0..i-1]) mod 2^32; count = offsets[n-1]+flags[n-1] mod 2^32, or 0 when empty. Flags are raw uint32 values.
y[s]=sum|min|max of x[offsets[s]..offsets[s+1]-1], empty=0; no mask or nonfinite filter. Min/max fold from type extrema (finite f32 extrema); integer sums wrap at 32 bits.
